ja: 私もちょっと騒音に閉口してます。
en: I'm slightly put out by the noise too.
alternatives: The noise is bothering me a little too.
I find the noise a little irritating too.
point: put out はここでは軽い不満や迷惑を表す。

ja: 清掃係にシーツを替えてもらった。
en: I got housekeeping to change the sheets.
alternatives: I had housekeeping change the sheets.
I had the sheets changed by housekeeping.
point: get + 人 + to do / have + 人 + 動詞で依頼の結果

ja: 私は駐車料を確認しとけばな。
en: I wish I'd checked parking fees.
alternatives: I wish I'd checked the parking charges.
If only I'd asked about parking charges.
point: wish + 過去完了で、料金を確認しなかったことを悔やむ。

ja: 私の朝食はまだ届かない。
en: My breakfast hasn't arrived yet.
alternatives: My breakfast hasn't come yet.
I haven't received my breakfast yet.
point: 否定の現在完了に yet を添える。

ja: 高いとはいえ、この眺めなら納得です。
en: Pricey as it is, the view justifies it.
alternatives: Even though it's pricey, the view is worth it.
Expensive though it is, the view is worth it.
point: 形容詞 + as it is で「〜ではあるが」

ja: 朝食の時間を教えてもらえますか？
en: Could you tell me when breakfast starts?
alternatives: Do you know what time breakfast starts?
Could you tell me what time breakfast is?
point: 間接疑問は when breakfast starts と平叙文の語順

ja: 私は追加料金を払わないよ。
en: I won't cough up extra fees.
alternatives: I'm not paying extra fees.
I refuse to pay extra charges.
point: cough up は渋々お金を出す。

ja: 宿が私たちに二重請求したかも。
en: The hotel might have double-billed us.
alternatives: The hotel may have charged us twice.
We may have been double-billed by the hotel.
point: double-bill は同じ料金を二重に請求する。

ja: もっと静かなら、昨夜眠れたのに。
en: If it were quieter, I'd have slept.
alternatives: If it were quieter, I'd have slept last night.
I'd have slept if it were quieter.
point: 今の状態 were と過去の結果 would have + 過去分詞

ja: 違う鍵をもらったに違いない。
en: I must've gotten the wrong key.
alternatives: I must have been given the wrong key.
They must have given me the wrong key.
point: 過去の確信は must have done

ja: Wi-Fi使える？
en: Can I use Wi-Fi?
alternatives: Is Wi-Fi available?
Can I connect to Wi-Fi?
Do you have Wi-Fi?
point: 「〜できますか」は Can I 〜?

ja: 入るとエアコンの故障に気づいた。
en: Walking in, I noticed the broken AC.
alternatives: Entering the room, I noticed the AC was broken.
As I walked in, I noticed the broken AC.
point: Walking in, で同時の動作を分詞構文にする

ja: 予約したのは禁煙室でした。
en: The room I booked was non-smoking.
alternatives: I booked a non-smoking room.
What I booked was a non-smoking room.
The one I reserved was non-smoking.
point: room の後ろに I booked を直接つなぐ

ja: 私は鍵をなくした。
en: I lost my key.
alternatives: My key went missing.
I misplaced my key.
point: lost は lose の過去形。

ja: 宿は私たちを自力で対処させた。
en: The hotel made us fend for ourselves.
alternatives: The hotel made us manage without help.
The hotel left us to manage without help.
point: fend for ourselves は助けなしに自力で対処する。

ja: 隣の部屋がうるさいです。
en: The next room is noisy.
alternatives: It's noisy next door.
The room next door is loud.
point: 「隣の部屋」は the next room か next door

ja: 隣の部屋の騒音がひどいんです。
en: The noise from next door is awful.
alternatives: The noise coming from next door is terrible.
The noise from the next room is awful.
point: from next door を名詞の後ろに置く

ja: 今日は掃除は結構です。
en: Please skip cleaning today.
alternatives: Please don't clean my room today.
No cleaning today, thanks.
point: 「しないで」は Don't か skip で言える

ja: 部屋が思ったより狭い。
en: The room's smaller than I expected.
alternatives: This room is smaller than I thought.
The room is smaller than I'd expected.
point: than の後は I expected で十分（it は不要）

ja: 私の到着前に宿は埋まってた。
en: It'd filled up before I arrived.
alternatives: The hotel had filled up before I arrived.
It'd become fully booked before I arrived.
point: had filled up は到着より前に満室になったこと。

ja: タオル数枚ください。
en: Some towels, please.
alternatives: Can I have some towels?
I need some towels.
point: 数が決まらない複数は some towels

ja: 昨日、予約を変更しました。
en: I changed my reservation yesterday.
alternatives: I modified my reservation yesterday.
I changed my booking yesterday.
point: yesterday があるので過去形

ja: 部屋が綺麗なら私は大金も払うのに。
en: Were the room clean, I'd pay through the nose.
alternatives: If the room were clean, I'd pay a fortune.
I'd pay big money if the room were clean.
point: pay through the nose は法外な大金を払うこと。

ja: 私は苦情を正式に申し立てたい。
en: I'd like to file a complaint.
alternatives: I'd like to lodge a complaint.
I'd like to make an official complaint.
point: file a complaint は正式に苦情を申し立てる。

ja: 私は食い違う案内を整理してる。
en: I'm reconciling conflicting directions.
alternatives: I'm sorting out conflicting directions.
I'm resolving inconsistencies in the directions.
point: reconcile は食い違う案内を整理して一致させる。

ja: エアコン昨日から壊れてる。
en: The AC's been broken since yesterday.
alternatives: The AC hasn't worked since yesterday.
The AC has been out since yesterday.
point: since と継続は現在完了

ja: 予約した部屋と、ずいぶん違いますね。
en: It's a far cry from what we booked.
alternatives: This room is nothing like what we booked.
This is not at all what we booked.
point: a far cry from = 大違い。what 節が前置詞の目的語

ja: 天井から水が漏れています。
en: Water's leaking from the ceiling.
alternatives: The ceiling is leaking.
Water is coming from the ceiling.
point: 今起きている最中は進行形

ja: 少し待ってもらえますか？
en: Do you mind waiting?
alternatives: Would you mind waiting a moment?
Could you wait a moment?
point: mind の後ろは -ing 形

ja: こんなに狭い部屋は、見たことがない。
en: Never have I seen such a tiny room.
alternatives: I've never seen such a tiny room.
I've never seen a room this small.
point: Never を前に出すと助動詞が主語の前に来る

ja: この部屋は禁煙ですか？
en: Is this room nonsmoking?
alternatives: Is this a no-smoking room?
Is this room smoke-free?
point: 「禁煙の」は nonsmoking か no-smoking

ja: 私は今払わなきゃ。
en: I must pay now.
alternatives: I have to pay now.
I need to pay now.
point: must で支払いの必要を表す。

ja: 遅く着いたので、夕食を逃した。
en: Arriving late, I missed dinner.
alternatives: Since I arrived late, I missed dinner.
I arrived late, so I missed dinner.
point: 分詞構文の主語は主節と同じ。Arriving で理由を示す

ja: 立地はいいが、部屋が古びている。
en: Although it's well located, the room's dated.
alternatives: The location's great, though the room's dated.
Although the location is great, the room is run-down.
point: Although 節は but を重ねず、1文に収める

ja: 私の予約は勝手に取り消された。
en: My reservation was canceled without permission.
alternatives: My booking was canceled without my consent.
They canceled my reservation without asking me.
point: without authorization は許可なく。

ja: 遅れるようなら、連絡します。
en: I'll call if I'm running late.
alternatives: I'll let you know if I'm late.
If I'm running late, I'll call you.
I'll give you a call if I'm delayed.
point: if 節は未来のことでも現在形（I'm）

ja: 朝食は無料ですか？
en: Is breakfast free?
alternatives: Is breakfast included?
Is the breakfast free?
point: 無料は free。食事名に冠詞は付けない

ja: ここに虫がいます。
en: There's a bug here.
alternatives: There's an insect here.
We have a bug here.
point: 虫が一匹いるなら there is a bug。

ja: 隣が一晩中うるさいんです。
en: Next door's been noisy all night.
alternatives: The neighbors have been noisy all night.
It's been noisy next door all night.
point: 「一晩中ずっと」は現在完了進行形

ja: 予約していれば、泊まれたのに。
en: If I'd booked, I could've stayed.
alternatives: If I had booked, I could have stayed.
I could've stayed if I'd booked.
point: 過去の仮定は had done と could have done

ja: ドライヤーください。
en: A hair dryer, please.
alternatives: Could I get a hair dryer?
I'd like a hair dryer.
point: 数えられる単数の物には a を付ける

ja: フロントは朝食を無料にすると言った。
en: The front desk said they'd comp my breakfast.
alternatives: They said breakfast would be on the house.
They said they'd give me breakfast on the house.
The front desk told me they'd comp my breakfast.
point: 「無料にする」は comp。said に合わせ will は would

ja: 朝食は何時からですか？
en: What time does breakfast start?
alternatives: What time is breakfast served?
When does breakfast start?
point: 「何時」は What time で始める

ja: 窓を開けてもいいですか？
en: May I open the window?
alternatives: Can I open the window?
Could I open the window?
point: 許可を求めるなら May I 〜?

ja: 金庫を使うといいですよ。
en: You should use the safe.
alternatives: You'd better use the safe.
Using the safe is a good idea.
point: 「〜するといい」は should

ja: 問題は、お湯が出ないことなんです。
en: It's the hot water that isn't working.
alternatives: What's not working is the hot water.
What's wrong is that the hot water isn't working.
point: 問題の的を絞るなら It's ～ that の形

ja: 私は預けた荷物を受け取ってない。
en: I haven't retrieved the bags I left.
alternatives: I haven't gotten my bags back yet.
I haven't collected the bags I left.
point: 預けた動作は過去形、未返却は現在完了で表す。

ja: もっと静かな宿がよかった。
en: I wish I'd chosen somewhere quieter.
alternatives: I should have picked a quieter hotel.
If only I'd chosen a quieter hotel.
I wish I'd chosen a quieter place.
point: 過去の後悔は wish + had done

ja: ホテル側は券で私をあしらった。
en: The hotel fobbed me off with a voucher.
alternatives: The hotel brushed me off with a voucher.
The hotel offered a voucher to dismiss me.
point: fob someone off は適当な対応で相手をあしらうこと。

ja: もう一泊したいのですが。
en: I'd like to stay another night.
alternatives: I'd like to stay one more night.
Could I stay one more night?
point: I'd like to + 動詞で丁寧に希望を伝える

ja: 私は係員に来てほしい。
en: I want an attendant to come.
alternatives: I'd like an attendant to come.
I want an attendant here.
point: want + 人 + to come で係員に来てほしいと伝える。
